trends.name: Iran Conflict Oil Shock
trends.summary: Brent crude surges to $106/bbl following US attack on Kharg Island, creating immediate energy price volatility. Geopolitical tensions threaten Strait of Hormuz stability with Trump signaling coalition reluctance to enforce protection. Oil shocks driving yield increases and inflation concerns despite stock market resilience.

trends.name: AI Chip Manufacturing Race
trends.summary: Tesla enters AI chip production with investor enthusiasm; Nvidia reports $1 trillion in orders for Blackwell and Vera Rubin chips through 2027 at GTC 2026. Semiconductor sector positioning as critical amid AI infrastructure buildout and geopolitical tensions.

trends.name: AI Bubble Reset Warning
trends.summary: Bill Gurley signals an AI sector reset is coming after early-stage winners saw rapid valuations spike. Market correction risks as valuations disconnect from fundamentals in the AI space.

trends.name: Private Equity Dividend Hikes
trends.summary: Ares Management spikes dividend yield with 20% hike as AUM hits record levels; Blue Owl Capital raises growth-as-risk concerns. Private equity sector showing strong returns but signaling caution on valuation expansion.

trends.name: Healthcare Sector Consolidation
trends.summary: HCA Healthcare presenting at major conferences signaling sector activity; healthcare inflation and geopolitical disruptions creating both risks and M&A opportunities. Structural healthcare demand remains strong despite cyclical pressures.

trends.name: Tech M&A Strategic Moves
trends.summary: Apple acquires MotionVFX to boost subscriber retention and expand content capabilities. Tech giants using acquisitions to defend streaming and ecosystem moats amid competitive pressures.

trends.name: Rare Earth Supply Chain
trends.summary: MP Materials positioned as America's rare earth champion amid geopolitical tensions and semiconductor supply chain concerns. Critical materials demand rising as US reshores advanced manufacturing.

trends.name: Treasury Yields Rising
trends.summary: Oil shocks and inflation concerns pushing Treasury yields higher as markets price in sustained energy price pressures. Dollar strengthening on safe-haven demand and inflation expectations from Iran conflict.

trends.name: Workplace AI Adoption Friction
trends.summary: Employers report AI boosts worker productivity but creates workplace friction and trust issues. Human factors and organizational change management emerging as key adoption barriers beyond technology deployment.

trends.name: Homebuilding Cyclical Headwinds
trends.summary: Champion Homes facing structural opportunities but near-term cyclical headwinds from rate environment and consumer demand softness. Housing sector bifurcated between luxury strength and affordability pressures.

trends.name: Buyback Acceleration
trends.summary: Salesforce rapidly expanding stock buybacks signaling management confidence and capital return priorities. Buyback activity rising across mega-cap tech despite valuation concerns from AI bubble warnings.

trends.name: Preferred Shares Value Play
trends.summary: Annaly Capital preferred shares offering 8.9% dividend yield entering buy zone after recent weakness. Fixed-income sector showing renewed value as rate environment stabilizes and credit spreads widen.
